summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on C++ experience spanning embedded firmware, GPU kernel optimization, and multi-tiered distributed systems. Architected a three-layer distributed application (mobile client, edge server, embedded controller) linked over a unified networking fabric, and built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed 3D viewport using OOP/OOAD design principles. Comfortable with multicore and MPI-based distributed computing, CUDA performance optimization, and Linux development environments.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Built a real-time data-acquisition GUI application in Python using PyQt and Matplotlib for laboratory experiment visualization, demonstrating GUI/desktop application development
Used GitLab for revision control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Designed and implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using data structures and algorithms and software design principles (z-axis differential thresholding), resolving sensor jitter through systematic calibration and resolution tuning

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Architected a multi-tiered distributed systems design (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller) linked via TCP/UDP socket programming over a unified WebSocket fabric
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics in C++ on Arduino, driving five servos with range-gated contact detection for reliable pick-and-place
Deployed the Jetson-side service via systemd (auto-restart, non-root isolation) with static IP networking on Linux for reliable multi-device registration

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI application with an OpenGL-backed 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies and SE(3) poses in real time
Applied OOP/OOAD to decouple the data model, math engine, and UI into separate modules via a mix-in pattern

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript convolution layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant-memory buffers, eliminating per-layer allocation overhead
Achieved a 35% speedup (49.2ms vs 73.3ms) over the uncoalesced kernel through efficient global memory management

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work-distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue) across multicore processors via MPI for 5000x5000 pixel scene rendering
Achieved up to 30x speedup with 55 processes; demonstrated dynamic task queuing outperforming static methods under unpredictable workloads

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) with deterministic memory management, achieving a 3.68KB Flash / 1.58KB RAM footprint at a 1Hz real-time update rate
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions and interrupt-driven sample capture with a low-level I2C driver
